title: Trust in AI emerges from distrust in humans: A machine learning study on decision-making guidance

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the frequency and predictors of participants choosing AI models (e.g., ChatGPT) over human agents across 30 decision-making scenarios, specifically evaluating how distrust in humans transfers to over-reliance or 'deferred trust' in AI.

Using K-Modes clustering on scenario-based agent selections to identify context-specific human preferences, demonstrating a strong cognitive bias toward AI in fact-based and logical decision-making contexts.
